title: A2A Core Logic
summary: This module provides the core logic for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, enabling agents to delegate tasks and kickoff processes to other agents. It integrates A2A capabilities into existing agent operations, handling both synchronous and asynchronous execution flows.

nodes.label: A2A Async Task Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Task Execution
nodes.description: Wraps the asynchronous task execution to enable Agent-to-Agent delegation if A2A is configured for the agent.

nodes.label: A2A Sync Task Wrapper
nodes.title: Synchronous Task Execution
nodes.description: Wraps the synchronous task execution to enable Agent-to-Agent delegation if A2A is configured for the agent.

nodes.label: A2A Async Kickoff Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Agent Kickoff
nodes.description: Wraps the asynchronous agent kickoff process to incorporate A2A delegation capabilities.

nodes.label: A2A Sync Kickoff Wrapper
nodes.title: Synchronous Agent Kickoff
nodes.description: Wraps the synchronous agent kickoff process to incorporate A2A delegation capabilities.

nodes.label: Retrieve Agent Card
nodes.title: Fetch Agent Configuration Card
nodes.description: Fetches an agent's configuration card from a specified endpoint using A2A configuration, handling potential network or authentication errors.

nodes.label: Identify A2A Agents & Model
nodes.title: Determine A2A Delegation Targets
nodes.description: Analyzes the agent's A2A configuration to identify target agents for delegation and their expected response models.

nodes.label: Execute A2A Task (Async)
nodes.title: Internal Async A2A Task Logic
nodes.description: Handles the core asynchronous logic for delegating and executing tasks through the A2A mechanism, integrating with original task functions and extensions.

nodes.label: Execute A2A Task (Sync)
nodes.title: Internal Sync A2A Task Logic
nodes.description: Handles the core synchronous logic for delegating and executing tasks through the A2A mechanism, integrating with original task functions and extensions.

nodes.label: Perform A2A Kickoff (Async)
nodes.title: Internal Async A2A Kickoff Logic
nodes.description: Manages the core asynchronous process of initiating an agent's workflow with A2A delegation, leveraging original kickoff functions and extensions.

nodes.label: Perform A2A Kickoff (Sync)
nodes.title: Internal Sync A2A Kickoff Logic
nodes.description: Manages the core synchronous process of initiating an agent's workflow with A2A delegation, leveraging original kickoff functions and extensions.

nodes.label: Original Async Task Logic
nodes.title: Standard Asynchronous Task Execution
nodes.description: The default, non-A2A asynchronous task execution logic of an agent, used as a fallback or part of the A2A flow.

nodes.label: Original Sync Task Logic
nodes.title: Standard Synchronous Task Execution
nodes.description: The default, non-A2A synchronous task execution logic of an agent, used as a fallback or part of the A2A flow.

nodes.label: Original Async Kickoff Logic
nodes.title: Standard Asynchronous Agent Kickoff
nodes.description: The default, non-A2A asynchronous kickoff logic for an agent, used as a fallback or part of the A2A flow.

nodes.label: Original Sync Kickoff Logic
nodes.title: Standard Synchronous Agent Kickoff
nodes.description: The default, non-A2A synchronous kickoff logic for an agent, used as a fallback or part of the A2A flow.

nodes.label: A2A Extension System
nodes.title: A2A Extension Management
nodes.description: A registry and mechanism for managing and applying A2A extensions that can modify or enhance delegation behavior.

nodes.label: External Agent Card Fetch
nodes.title: Utility for Fetching Agent Cards
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for making external requests to retrieve agent capability cards.

nodes.label: A2A Configuration
nodes.title: Agent-to-Agent Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration object defining A2A settings, including endpoints, authentication, and timeouts.

nodes.label: Agent Capability Card
nodes.title: Agent's Public Interface
nodes.description: A data structure representing the capabilities, interface, and metadata of an agent for A2A delegation.

groups.label: A2A Entrypoints
groups.title: Public A2A Delegation Wrappers
groups.description: These components serve as the primary entry points for enabling Agent-to-Agent communication within task execution and agent kickoff processes.

groups.label: A2A Core Processing
groups.title: Internal A2A Delegation Logic
groups.description: These components handle the internal mechanics of identifying A2A agents and orchestrating the actual delegation and execution of tasks or kickoffs.

groups.label: Configuration & Discovery
groups.title: Agent Card Management
groups.description: This component is responsible for retrieving and managing agent capability cards based on A2A configuration.
